entities.summary: Paleo-eskimo culture in greenland existing from around 2500 bce until about 800 bce (2499 BCE – 799 BCE). Saqqaq culture is a archaeological culture, spanning 2499 BCE to 799 BCE. A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
